headline: U.S. midterm voting day: polls close tonight as Canada awaits Thursday's budget
briefing: Americans are voting today in midterm elections that decide control of Congress; polls begin closing at 6 PM ET and the last close at 1 AM ET, and close races may take days to call. Closer to home, Canada's federal budget lands Thursday, Nov. 5, and Toronto police and the SIU continue to look into the overnight standoff at U of T Mississauga. Several stories are carried over from earlier today; no major new developments were confirmed in this refresh.
